const P: path = segment(start: (0, 0), end: (3, 4))
const Q: path = segment(start: (0, 0), end: (5, 12))
const Values: path[] = [@P, @Q]
const Reverse: path[] = [@Q, @P]
module Pick(items: path[]) {
 export const out: path = @items[1]
 export const count: number = @items.length
}
instance One = Pick(items: @Values)
instance Two = Pick(items: @Reverse)
const Result: path = @One::out
const Other: path = @Two::out
const L: number = @Result.length
const M: number = @Other.length
const X: number = @Result.endPoint.x
const Y: number = @Other.endPoint.x
const N: number = @One::count

}

const Values: Seed[] = [@A, Seed(n: 0)]
const Mapped: Shape[] = for item in @Values { Shape(p: segment(start: (@item.n, 2), end: (@item.n + 3, 6 / @item.n)), n: @item.n + 2) }

export const out: path = @Chosen.p
}
instance One = Make(n: 1)
const First: path = @One::out
